The draft plan assigns general grounds work on Mondays and Wednesdays from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m., places three students in the work group, and names a school staff member as the on-site supervisor. Before I can sign off, our standard pre-approval routine requires the career teacher, counselor, nurse, and employer liaison to each report relevant information. I'd like to go through each of those areas now so I can verify the requirements and get this authorized. Who would like to start?
